postConversation.question: If you have 2 slices out of 6 total slices, what fraction is that?

probes: You have 2 slices. There are 6 total. Which number goes on top?
The pieces you have go on top. The total goes on bottom. What do you get?
It's 2 over 6. How do we write that as a fraction?
Two on top, six on bottom. Say the fraction!
It's 2/6! Two slices out of six. Great job!
